text:
ravi: Starting a config-only rollout for micro-routing and batching knobs in the 06:00-06:30 UTC window. Canary plan: 1% -> 8% -> 40% -> 100%. Watch p95, p99, and kvcache_free_pct.

deploy-bot: DeployBot started canary 7901234567 for cfg-microtune-06. Stages scheduled: 1% (+6m) -> 8% (+12m) -> 40% (+20m) -> 100% (+30m). Running quick smoke.

elaine: Changes: per-tenant max_batch 14->9, route timeout 1100->800ms, geo weight small shift us-east->eu-west. Added tenant concurrency floor=1.

nate: Abort criteria: p95 > 1.4x baseline for 3m, any pod OOM, or kvcache_free_pct < 65%. Rollback cmd pinned: rbctl rollback cfg-microtune-06 && deploybot pin-route --route=global --model=v3.

deploy-bot: Canary 1% live (7901234580). Smoke: ok. Metrics snapshot: p95 162ms (baseline 155), p99 390ms, kvcache_free_pct 83%.

ravi: Proceeding to 8%.

deploy-bot: Progressed to 8% (7901234600). Snapshot: p95 168ms, p99 405ms, kvcache_free_pct 80%. No aborts.

deploy-bot: Reached 100% at 7901234625. Final: p95 156ms, p99 400ms, kvcache_free_pct 81%. No OOMs.

elaine: Release notes updated: "config: reduce max_batch 14->9, lower routing timeout to 800ms, minor geo weight rebalance; fallback to cpu-quant-v1 on tenant latency spike." Post-deploy: monitor SLOs 2h, keep canary tag 24h. Thanks.
